import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/guildSecretRealmWar/view/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const text = (e.MessageText || '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?灵脉攻防战查看(?:\s+(\d+)(?:\s+(\d+))?)?\s*$/);

  if (!m) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const realmNo = m[1] ? Number(m[1]) : null;
  const result = await App({ bid, realmNo, page: Number(m[2] || 1) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code === 'NEED_REALM_NO') {
    md.addText('用法：/灵脉攻防战查看 秘境编号 [页码]');
  } else if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);
  } else {
    for (const item of result.data.positions as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
      const owner = typeof item.occupiedUserName === 'string' && item.occupiedUserName.length > 0 ? item.occupiedUserName : `NPC#${item.npcId}`;

      md.addText(`${item.positionNo}号位｜${item.positionPoints}分｜${owner}\n挑战：/灵脉攻防战挑战 ${realmNo} ${item.positionNo}\n`);
    }
  }
  void message.send(
    FormatGui({ isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false, bid, title: '灵脉攻防战', content: md, footer: [{ label: '攻防列表', command: '/灵脉攻防战列表 1' }] })
  );
});
